title: A Spectral Framework for Closed-Form Relative Density Estimation
abstract: arXiv:2605.10668v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We propose a closed-form spectral framework for relative log-density estimation in linearly parameterized probabilistic models, including unnormalized and conditional models. This is achieved by representing the Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence as an integral of weighted chi-squared divergences, converting KL estimation into a family of least-squares problems. We derive an explicit spectral formula based only on first- and second-order feature moments, yielding closed-form estimators of both divergences and log-density potentials for fixed features. The framework extends to a broad class of $f$-divergences and can be combined with kernelization or feature learning with neural networks (with then only a closed form for the last layer). We prove convergence guarantees for the resulting estimators and empirically compare them on synthetic data with optimization-based variational formulations, including logistic and softmax regression fo

translated_title: 闭式相对密度估计的谱方法框架
translated_abstract: 我们提出了一个闭式谱方法框架，用于线性参数化概率模型（包括非归一化模型和条件模型）中的相对对数密度估计。该方法通过将Kullback-Leibler（KL）散度表示为加权卡方散度的积分，将KL散度估计转化为一系列最小二乘问题。我们仅基于一阶和二阶特征矩推导出显式的谱公式，从而在固定特征下得到散度和对数密度势函数的闭式估计器。该框架可扩展至广泛的f-散度类别，并可与核方法或基于神经网络的特征学习相结合（此时仅最后一层具有闭式解）。我们证明了所得估计器的收敛性保证，并在合成数据上与基于优化的变分方法（包括逻辑回归和softmax回归等）进行了实证比较。
tldr: 该论文提出一种谱方法框架，通过将KL散度表示为加权卡方散度的积分并转化为最小二乘问题，仅利用一阶和二阶特征矩即可获得相对对数密度及多种f-散度的闭式估计器，并证明了其收敛性保证。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a spectral framework that converts KL divergence estimation into a family of least-squares problems via weighted chi-squared divergences, yielding closed-form estimators of relative log-densities and a broad class of f-divergences using only first- and second-order feature moments, with proven convergence guarantees.
